svg.aria-label: UI architecture as deployed: browser → CloudFront → ALB → Next.js app and BFF on ECS Fargate Spot → identity service (API Gateway + Lambda), AgentCore Runtime (LangGraph, Bedrock models via a cross-account role, Jev, resolver, DuckDB over the S3 serving set) and DynamoDB → DynamoDB Streams → realtime-publisher Lambda → AppSync Events pushed back to the browsers over WebSocket. Animated: sign-in, login warm-up, a turn, a code-checked confirmation, the trace push, a handoff reaching the staff queue, a human takeover, and a customer message that skips the runtime.
svg.text: 3 JWT kept in an httpOnly Secure cookie, never in JS
so the microVM is up before the first message
app + BFF route handlers · Zod in · role check
· clients: fetch after cursor, then listen
· no AWS credentials in the browser
· history read only after owner check
DuckDB over the S3 serving set
turn cap · idempotent on msg id
WebSocket · AppSync Events · subscribe-only realtime token · onSubscribe checks channel vs claims
① Sign in: /api/auth/login → IdP login ticket → /api/auth/otp → RS256 JWT (15 min) in an httpOnly Secure cookie
② Warm-up: after(OTP) the BFF sends {"warmup": true} to this conversation's runtime session → microVM starts before message 1
③ /api/chat → AgentCore (Bearer JWT · session id · message id) → graph calls Bedrock, Jev, resolver, DuckDB → DynamoDB
reply returns to the chat: «Tu tarjeta •••• 3381 tiene USD 1,240.50 disponibles»
④ Confirm: the card's button sends confirm:<card_hash>; code compares it, no model reads the "yes" → dispute filed
⑤ decision_records Stream → publisher → /trace/<sid> → demo stage and /trace show Jev probs, thresholds, rule results
⑥ «No reconozco un cargo de $420 en Amazon» → Jev reports_unauthorized_use ≥ threshold → handoff written
⑦ handoffs Stream → publisher → /queue/all → staff console queue (live, no refresh)
⑧ Take over: sessions.control = human + handoff in_takeover (one transaction) + system message → /session/<sid> → «Ana se unió»
⑨ Customer writes while control = human → BFF stores the message, AgentCore not called → pushed to the staff console
